Question: Driving along a highway, Megan noticed that her odometer showed \(15951\) (miles). This number is a palindrome—it reads the same forward and backward. Then \(2\) hours later, the odometer displayed the next higher palindrome. What was her average speed, in miles per hour, during this \(2\)-hour period?
